name: tokens
title: Interaction Tokens
description: Shared interaction-state tokens: surface-relative hover/active overlays (bg-hover, bg-active), the selected fill, the see-through secondary-button tint (--tint, --tint-hover), the destructive-light ground, the --overlay RGB triplet, the --fluid-accent color (switch track, drop and swatch rings, copy highlight) with --focus-ring derived from it, the accent text selection, and the base-layer :focus-visible fallback ring.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/surfaces. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#surfaces.
